priorityConclusion: The smallest next useful development is an ordinary-runtime lifecycle integration probe for retained MaterialReady plus an unfinished upload during native Disable. The production path is already wired and component tests actually pass; the missing proof is the combined normal configured TLS/Net/Hub/worker/UI path with live file owners. Do not describe this as missing cleanup implementation or reimplement a second runtime.
existingProductWiring: https_runtime::run negative stop closes Web admission, cancels both Hubs and Net, submits CleanupTask through the same HttpExecutor, requires Net idle + settled sessions + actual cleanup ticket return + both confirm_live_drained before native/SSPI destruction and physical thread receipt.

application::schedule_shutdown returns while !teacher_https_quiescent; backup_controller requires the same gate before taking original pool/Writer for restore; no-code reinitialization enters begin_shutdown and waits shutdown_complete.

The component regression actually exercises MaterialReady, a suppressed Begin and a real download pin while the original worker pool remains usable, and exact old claim/session/queued Writer negative tests pass.
notYetCombined: ordinary_https_probe explicitly reports material_ready_stop=NOT_EXERCISED; its real authenticated request sequence is reminders and two clean native start/stop generations, with no material transfer in flight.
The passing MaterialReady/pin test directly constructs component Hubs and calls live CleanupTask; it is not an actual configured native RuntimeOwner stop over real TLS.
Existing reset/recovery entry and full reset/restore probes do not establish an active ordinary HTTPS material owner at their irreversible handoff, so they do not prove this cross-domain composition.
minimalNextImplementation: Extend the existing owned ordinary fixture/client rendezvous, preserving actual teacher pairing, native Enable/Disable, original two workers and single physical runtime.

Create one real authenticated material upload, finish bytes successfully and deliberately omit Append, leaving MaterialReady. Start a second authenticated body upload and send only a bounded prefix, keeping that original connection/request alive. Do not fabricate a Hub entry or readiness flag.

After real upload success/partial-body observations, use the native confirmed Disable already exercised by the probe. Require stop to finish under its original5s budget; retain originals and mark FAIL on timeout.

Use exact owned root/process identity to read only synthetic staging file presence/absence before/after stop, require no pending native/Net ticket at actual owner quiescence, and exercise a fresh local shared-worker query after Disable.

Start second configured generation, require old teacher cookie rejected, pair a fresh teacher through the normal native approval, and complete a fresh upload to demonstrate actual capacity/permit reuse. Record counts/statuses only; never archive code/cookie/CSRF/response bodies containing credentials.
validation: Architecture check12crates/33edges, format/strict Clippy and same-source GNU compile under existing budgets.

Real Win11 loopback trusted owned IP-SAN TLS1.2, actual clean successful response EOF before retained-MaterialReady disable, partial upload never treated as complete, original staged-file cleanup and original worker query/new-generation upload.

Keep all failure transcripts, exact source/build/EXE hashes and cleanup receipts; separately retain Win7/Win10/campus/Seewo scope. Existing1542 component tests remain regression evidence, not the new integration proof.
followupsSeparate: A real slow download must be demonstrated actually holding its exact native pin at the stop trigger, not merely an unconsumed client response already sent by the server. Add this as a separate bounded scenario; verify actual sharing-lock evidence and old pin release before replacement.

Then run no-code reset and confirmed restore from an active ordinary HTTPS domain with retained material/partial body. Minimal additional files: application/reinitialize_entry_tests.rs, application/backup_shutdown_tests.rs plus the ordinary native probe/runner orchestration; modify production schedule/restore code only if an actual counterexample reveals a missing gate.

Suppressed Begin and queued SQL already have real component regressions. A combined normal-path stress probe needs narrowly scoped existing-worker synchronization to establish the stage without creating a second pool or bypassing ordinary auth. Do not add synthetic readiness solely to pass it.
nonChanges: Desktop public explicit actions and passive timetable/clock/calendar/countdown untouched
